subject.title: [Bug]: openai-completions fallback candidate is selected, but fallback does not complete successfully through an OpenAI-compatible proxy

question: Should this remaining proxy fallback report wait for a failed request/response capture before adding any strict-minimal or feature-disabling provider mode?
rationale: Current code proves the real agent request is broader than the reporter's minimal direct POST, but the exact incompatible field is unknown and adding a new provider mode/config surface is a product compatibility choice.

options.title: Require request capture first
options.body: Keep the issue open for a redacted failed OpenClaw request body plus proxy status/body before choosing sanitizer, diagnostics, docs, or new config surface.

options.title: Sponsor strict-minimal mode
options.body: Accept the config/product surface and design a default-off minimal Chat Completions mode with schema, docs, and upgrade tests even before this proxy's exact failing field is known.

options.title: Scope to documentation only
options.body: Treat current compat flags and troubleshooting docs as the supported path unless a new reproduction proves a specific OpenClaw request-shape bug.

recommendation.title: Require request capture first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open for a redacted failed OpenClaw request body plus proxy status/body before choosing sanitizer, diagnostics, docs, or new config surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The live issue is assigned to osolmaz, so they are the best available owner for deciding whether this stays evidence-gated or becomes new provider/config surface.
